profile.name: Bryan Murasira
profile.introduction: I’m Bryan, a full-stack software engineer and generative AI engineer based in Kigali, Rwanda.
profile.about: My work brings together web applications, backend systems, and generative AI. This portfolio collects projects across catalog intelligence, recruitment, cultural events, and commerce.

projects.title: Umucyo Catalog AI
projects.summary: AI-assisted catalog classification, schema generation, and item registration—with human review built into the workflow.

sections.heading: Catalog intelligence, with a human in the loop.
sections.text: Umucyo Catalog AI supports the preparation and review of procurement catalog records. Its workflows cover commodity fields, item cleanup, reclassification, duplicate search, and the registration of new items.

sections.heading: From a description to a reviewed record.
sections.text: A new-item workflow takes a description through clarifications, commodity selection, attribute review, and wording. A contracting authority reviews the submission before it becomes a published catalog item. AI suggestions remain part of a reviewable process.

projects.title: Talent OP
projects.summary: A recruitment platform connecting job discovery, applications, and employer workflows.

sections.heading: Two sides of the hiring process.
sections.text: Talent OP brings candidate and employer journeys into a recruitment platform. Candidates can discover jobs and apply, while employer dashboards support job publishing and hiring workflows.

sections.heading: An application beyond the landing page.
sections.text: The interface connects public job listings with authenticated candidate and employer areas. The project includes application flows, dashboard pages, and messaging interfaces.

projects.title: Vodun Days
projects.summary: A festival application for exploring activities, venues, the agenda, and event updates.

sections.heading: The festival, in your pocket.
sections.text: Vodun Days celebrates Vodun arts, culture, and spirituality in Ouidah, Benin. The application brings together an agenda, activity details, venues, and news for festival visitors.

projects.title: Emart
projects.summary: Commerce software bringing together products, orders, inventory, customers, and user permissions.

sections.heading: The operations behind commerce.
sections.text: Emart connects product, order, stock, customer, and user management. A typed REST API supports the commerce application and its administrative workflows.
